libgomp keeps its thread pool across regions, so\n// pinning once up front is enough.\nvoid pinThreads() {\n    if (omp_get_proc_bind() != omp_proc_bind_false) return;\n\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) return;\n\n    std::vector<int> cpus;\n    for (int i = 0; CPUs are ordered the same way libgomp orders its\n// \"threads\" places (core by core, SMT siblings adjacent) so that consecutive thread ids,\n// which own neighbouring slabs under the static schedule, share a core's caches.\n// libgomp keeps its thread pool across regions, so pinning once up front is enough.\nvoid pinThreads() {\n    if (omp_get_proc_bind() != omp_proc_bind_false) return;\n\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) return;\n\n    std::vector<int> cpus;\n    std::vector<char> seen(CPU_SETSIZE, 0);\n    for (int i = 0; i < CPU_SETSIZE; ++i) {\n        if (!CPU_ISSET(i, &allowed) || seen[i]) continue;\n        char path[128];\n        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d/topology/thread_siblings_list\", i);\n        std::vector<int> group;\n        if (FILE* f = fopen(path, \"r\")) {\n            char buf[512];\n            if (fgets(buf, sizeof(buf), f)) group = parseCpuList(buf);\n            fclose(f);\n        }\n        if (group.empty()) group.push_back(i);\n        for (int c : group) {\n            if (c >= 0 && c < CPU_SETSIZE && CPU_ISSET(c, &allowed) && !seen[c]) {\n                seen[c] = 1;\n                cpus.push_back(c);\n            }\n        }\n        if (!seen[i]) { seen[i] = 1; cpus.push_back(i); }\n    }\n    if (cpus.empty()) return;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n        const int nthreads = omp_get_num_threads();\n        if (nthreads <= static_cast<int>(cpus.size())) {\n            cpu_set_t one;\n            CPU_ZERO(&one);\n            CPU_SET(cpus[static_cast<size_t>(tid)], &one);\n            sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(one), &one);  // Linux: pid 0 means the calling thread\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n'''\ns=s.replace(old,new)\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\ncd /tmp/omp && make 2>&1 | grep -E \"warning|error|Built\" && cd /tmp && (env -i ./omp/cahn_hilliard -x 256 -i 300 >/dev/null & pid=$!; sleep 2; echo \"--- Cpus_allowed_list of first 6 tasks ---\"; for t in $(ls /proc/$pid/task | sort -n | head -6); do grep Cpus_allowed_list /proc/$pid/task/$t/status; done; echo -n \"distinct pinned cpus: \"; cat /proc/$pid/task/*/status | grep Cpus_allowed_list | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u | wc -l; kill $pid; wait $pid 2>/dev/null); echo \"--- clean env 256^3 x50, x3 ---\"; for i in 1 2 3; do env -i ./omp/cahn_hilliard -x 256 -i 50 | grep -o \"[0-9.]* MCell\"; done | tr '\\n' ' '; echo; echo -n \"OMP_PROC_BIND=true: \"; OMP_PROC_BIND=true ./omp/cahn_hilliard -x 256 -i 50 | grep -o \"[0-9.]* MCell\"","description":"Pin threads in sibling-adjacent order, verify affinity via /proc, re-measure","timeout":300000},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1844,"cache_read_input_tokens":35492,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1844},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8d1f1fbb-48d1-451d-94e9-f1764ab3ac23","uuid":"06ae62dc-a13b-4a0c-ac42-5763fe812651","timestamp":"2026-10-25T08:51:44.711Z","request_id":"req_011CgNfoKrxJKKyAXMJbWdqG"}
